title: Equity Cradle
one_liner: Simulate a kid's SpaceX share or birth dividend compounding to age 65, and what they lose by selling early.
headline: Pick a kid's $146 SpaceX share or $2,000 birth dividend, set a growth-rate preset from the episode, and hit "Sell now" to watch exactly how much future value gets vaporized versus holding to 65.

episode.title: Chamath: AGI Is Here, Anthropic’s $100B Giveaway, Elon’s SpaceX Shares for 72M Kids | EP #304

history.summary: A tight, on-theme compound-growth visualizer that fully delivers the demo spec from the episode: birth year, asset choice, episode-sourced growth presets, animated log-scale chart, and a sell-vs-hold forfeiture stat. The prior review's blocking defect (a dead birth-year slider) has been properly fixed — it now drives calendar-year labels and a live "today" marker — and the forfeited-growth comparison was made more honest by reinvesting sold cash at 5%/yr instead of assuming it sits at $0. No new blocking issues found; remaining gaps are polish-level.
